people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

people.name: Libnah
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua; a Levitical city

translations.web: To the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Libnah with its pasture lands,
translations.bsb: So to the descendants of Aaron the priest they gave these cities, together with their pasturelands: Hebron, a city of refuge for the manslayer, Libnah,
translations.kjv: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,
translations.asv: And unto the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its suburbs, the city of refuge for the manslayer, and Libnah with its suburbs,
